standard_prerequisites.name: For U, U' as in condition (2) there is a canonical equality of derived tensor products RGamma(U, K) tensor O_{X'}(U') = RGamma(U', L(g')^*K), so the second arrow of (2) is induced by the given map L(g')^*K to K'
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the right hand arrow of the composition in (2) with pullback followed by the given map.

standard_prerequisites.name: The first arrow of the composition in (2) is the base change comparison map of More on Algebra for the affine opens involved
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the left hand arrow with the standard comparison map whose properties are established in More on Algebra.

standard_prerequisites.name: A map of modules over a ring is an isomorphism if and only if all localizations at primes are isomorphisms, in the form used to compare a module map with its stalkwise versions
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the equality of the displayed localized expressions into the equivalence of conditions (1) and (2).

core_obligations: Identify the two arrows of condition (2): the second comes from the equality RGamma(U, K) tensor^L O_{X'}(U') = RGamma(U', L(g')^*K) of Lemma quasi-coherence-pullback composed with the given arrow L(g')^*K to K', and the first is the More on Algebra comparison map (proof lines 6686-6693).

Observe (2) implies (3) trivially and that (1) is local on X', so it suffices to treat the affine case: assume X, S, S', X' affine and show (1) is equivalent to the displayed global composition being an isomorphism in D(O_{S'}(S')) (proof lines 6693-6698).

Translate to modules: write S = Spec R, X = Spec A, S' = Spec R', X' = Spec A' with A' = A tensor_R R', K corresponding to M^bullet and K' to N^bullet, so the condition is that M^bullet tensor_R^L R' to M^bullet tensor_A^L A' to N^bullet is an isomorphism in D(R'), equivalently that all cohomology maps are isomorphisms, the composite being a map of A'-modules (proof lines 6698-6721).

Compare with condition (1): at compatible primes the stalk of the cohomology map is the localization at q' of the module map just displayed, by the displayed identity H^i(M^bullet_q tensor R'_{p'}) tensor A'_{q'} = H^i(M^bullet tensor_R^L R') tensor_{A'} A'_{q'}; conclude the two conditions are equivalent by Algebra, Lemma characterize-zero-local (proof lines 6721-6746).
proof_roadmap: Identify the arrows of (2) via quasi-coherent pullback and the comparison map (proof lines 6686-6693).
Reduce to the affine case using locality of (1) on X' (proof lines 6693-6698).
Module translation: the affine condition is M^bullet tensor_R^L R' to M^bullet tensor_A^L A' to N^bullet being an isomorphism in D(R') (proof lines 6698-6721).
Conclude by comparing stalks at compatible primes and applying the characterization of zero maps (proof lines 6721-6746).
